home.heading: Your whole taiko journey on one page
home.lead: Sign in with your OurTaiko account to see every score you set on Fanmade and Database, collect titles and dan ranks, and choose the nameplate the game shows.
home.signInFailed: Signing in did not finish. Please try again.
home.scoresText: Both servers in one table: your best on each chart and every play.
home.titlesText: Pass online dan courses for dan badges and titles; titles from community courses say so.
home.plateText: Pick the title you wear and the 1P and 2P plates in the game follow.

profile.accountCenterDown: The account center is not answering; the nickname and avatar will show later.

scores.bestExplained: One row per chart: the highest score, and the best crown of all plays. When a chart's files were replaced, scores on the new version come first.
scores.sourceDown: {{name}} is not answering; showing the other servers for now.
scores.truncated: {{name}} has too many scores; showing the latest 2000.

titles.heldExplained: Titles earned from online dan courses and more.
titles.wearExplained: Wear one of your titles; your nameplate in the game and on the websites shows it.
titles.showDan: Show my highest dan rank on the nameplate
titles.catalogExplained: Every title there is to earn, as it looks on a nameplate.

dans.badgesExplained: Earned by passing official online dan courses: red for a red pass, gold for a gold pass. A badge only goes up.

admin.editTitleExplained: IDs use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens and cannot change. Saving an existing ID changes that title.
admin.name: Name
admin.official: Official title (community courses cannot give it)
admin.confirmDelete: Delete the title {{id}}? Players who hold it lose it too.
admin.grantExplained: For events and tests. The user ID is the account center's 32-character ID.
admin.title: Title

errors.unexpected: The server answered unexpectedly ({{status}}). Please try again later.
errors.CSRF_INVALID: Your session changed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.TITLE_NOT_HELD: You have not earned this title yet.
